description: Transcribe a clip project item's audio with Speech to Text (Premiere Pro 26.5 or later). Needs the language pack Premiere Pro uses; waits until the transcript is done, so raise PREMIERE_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS for long clips

item.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

name: transcribe_clip
title: Transcribe Clip
